tool_args.rationale: The observed s_grad reaches 2.44, above the specified 2.36 gray-zone gate. The targeted high-gradient probe can identify the supercritical threshold and avalanche strength before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches the uncertified supercritical gray zone, so a smooth branch cannot identify or rule out an avalanche threshold.
The ambiguity concerns the high-gradient threshold, not temporal resolution.
It does not discriminate the proposed threshold mechanism.
